seo_description: What a wedding photographer and videographer costs with Zen Visuals in 2026: photography £750, film £1,100, both £1,650. What's included, and how to book.
h1: Wedding photographer and videographer prices in Derbyshire
hero_alt: Bride and groom facing each other under a green bandstand
intro: Our prices are simple: wedding photography is £750, a wedding film is £1,100, and both together are £1,650, saving £200. Each price covers your whole wedding day, from getting ready to the last dance. There are no hourly packages and nothing extra for staying late.
Below is exactly what each price includes, what you can add, how paying works, and the questions couples ask us most before they book.

sections.heading: Wedding photography: £750
sections.text: Photographs of your whole day, from getting ready and the ceremony to portraits, speeches and the dance floor. The style is natural and unposed: we blend in and capture the day as it happens. Your photographs are usually ready within 3 to 6 weeks.

sections.heading: Wedding film: £1,100
sections.text: A 3–6 minute wedding film of your whole day. Every film is cut, colour graded and sound mixed by hand in DaVinci Resolve, which takes hours for every finished minute. At the bigger moments we add subtle sound design under the music and the real audio. Your film is usually ready within 3 to 6 weeks.

sections.heading: Photography and film together: £1,650
sections.text: Both of us, all day: one on photographs and one on film, so every angle is covered and nothing is missed. Booking both costs £1,650, which is £200 less than booking them separately.

sections.heading: Add your full ceremony and speeches: +£225
sections.text: With any film package you can add your full ceremony and every speech, filmed start to finish and edited as their own films alongside your wedding film. It's for £225 on top of your package.

sections.heading: How paying works
sections.text: Half of the price secures your date. Once it's paid, the day is yours and we won't take another booking. The rest is due whenever suits you, up to two weeks after the wedding.

sections.heading: Where we work, and travel
sections.text: We're based in Belper and cover the whole of Derbyshire, including Derby, Matlock, Ashbourne and the Peak District, and we travel across the UK. We've worked at venues including Shottle Hall and West Mill in Darley Abbey, and filmed a number of weddings in London.

sections.heading: What to compare when you're choosing
sections.text: When you compare photographers and videographers, check what the price covers: how many hours, how long the film is, how long you'll wait for it, and whether the person you meet is the person who turns up. Ours covers the whole day with no hourly limit, the film is 3–6 minutes, you'll have everything within 3–6 weeks, and it's always the two of us, Zuzia and Ben.

faqs.question: How much does a wedding photographer cost in Derbyshire?
faqs.answer: With Zen Visuals, wedding photography of your whole day is £750. There are no hourly packages.

faqs.question: How much does a wedding videographer cost in Derbyshire?
faqs.answer: Our wedding film is £1,100 for your whole day, edited into a 3–6 minute film within 3–6 weeks.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to book a photographer and videographer together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Booking our photography and film together is £1,650, which saves £200 compared with booking them separately.

faqs.question: Can we have our full ceremony and speeches filmed?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add your full ceremony and every speech to any film package for £225. They're edited as their own films alongside your wedding film.

faqs.question: How much is the deposit?
faqs.answer: Half of the price secures your date. The rest is due any time up to two weeks after the wedding.

faqs.question: Do you charge by the hour?
faqs.answer: No. Every price covers your whole wedding day, from getting ready to the last dance.
